Compute Levenshtein distance using provided weights for substitution.

public double Distance(string s1, string s2, double limit)

Parameters

s1 string

The first string to compare.

s2 string

The second string to compare.

limit double

The maximum result to compute before stopping. This means that the calculation can terminate early if you only care about strings with a certain similarity. Set this to Double.MaxValue if you want to run the calculation to completion in every case.

Returns

double

The computed weighted Levenshtein distance.

ArgumentNullException

If s1 or s2 is null.
